overall: The AG found the Worthington Selectboard did not violate the Open Meeting Law by withholding minutes of its October 1 and December 17, 2024 Purpose 1 executive sessions, because the matter was still being resolved; it reminded the Board to review nondisclosure periodically.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide minutes of its October 1 and December 17, 2024 executive sessions, which were held under Purpose 1.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by withholding the executive session minutes of the October 1 and December 17, 2024, meetings.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board continued to withhold the executive session minutes after publication would no longer defeat the lawful purpose of the sessions.
allegations.key_passage: Here, at the time of the request for minutes, the Board was still engaged in resolving the complaint.
